info.title: rampflow API
info.description:
The HTTP API of rampflow, generated from the routes by `pnpm api:docs` (ADR-0013).

Sign in with `POST /api/auth/login`; the `rf_session` cookie it sets authenticates the other requests. Every mutating request needs an `Origin` header with the app origin (ADR-0003). Routes under `/api/driver` use the `rf_driver` cookie of a driver link instead.

post.description: `{ email, password }` → 200 `{ ok }`; sets `rf_session`. A wrong password, an unknown, unverified or disabled email all answer the same 401; 429 `rate_limited` after 5 failures in 15 minutes for the email and client address, or 30 for the client address alone
204; deletes the session and clears the cookie
`{ email, locale? }`; 202. Sends only to verified, enabled accounts, in `locale` (the page's language, default `de`); stops sending after 5 per hour per email
`{ token }` → 200 `{ ok }`; sets `rf_session`; single use, 15 minutes

`{ token }` → 200 `{ email }` of the account the link signs in to, without using the link; 401 for an unknown, used or expired link. `/auth/magic` shows it and exchanges only after the holder clicks "Continue as" (login CSRF)
`{ email, locale? }`; 202, as for the magic link (unverified accounts included)
`{ token, password }` → 200 `{ ok }`; sets the password, verifies the email, deletes every session of the user and signs this browser in; single use, 60 minutes

get.description: `?siteId&loadTypeId&date&loadUnits`; `PortalOffers` with lead time and horizon applied; 404 for a load type carriers cannot book

post.description: `{ clientRequestId, siteId, loadTypeId, startsAt, avis }`; 201 `PortalBookingView`, 200 for a repeated `clientRequestId`; 409 with `offers` when the last unit went elsewhere

patch.description: `{ startsAt, version }`; before the cutoff, else 409 `cutoff_passed`

put.description: `{ avis, version }`; before the cutoff; 409 when the new duration does not fit, and the avis stays

post.description: `{ reason? }`; before the cutoff; revokes the driver link
regenerate; `{ url, expiresAt }`
`{ email, locale }` with one of the 12 driver locales; 202

get.description: `?siteId=`; active, carrier-bookable only: `{ items: [{ id, name, direction }] }`
`{ items }`: active sites with address, phone, `timeZone`, `cutoffMinutes`, `leadMinutes`, `horizonDays` and `avisRules`

all tenants; `?tenantId&siteId&from&to&status&when&order&limit&cursor`; `from` and `to` are site-local dates of each booking's start; `when=upcoming` keeps trucks on site and requested or confirmed bookings starting today or later in site time, `when=past` keeps the rest (every final booking, and pending ones from earlier days); `order` is `asc` (default, by start) or `desc` (the past, newest first); `{ items: PortalBookingSummary[], nextCursor }`
`PortalBookingView`
`{ url, expiresAt }`; 404 without an active link
`{ tenantId, siteId, loadTypeId, avis }`: the avis without references and driver; no date
The carrier context of the signed-in member: org, role, permissions and linked tenants.
`{ items }`: every tenant the carrier is linked to or registered at, with `link` (status, since) and the newest `registration` (status, reject reason)
as the staff list, without site lists

post.description: `{ email, role }` → 201; the email goes out in the inviter's locale

delete.description: Revokes an invitation; the link stops working.
Removes a member from the carrier.

get.description: `DriverBookingView`: `asOf`, `channel`, tenant name and logo URL, site name, address lines, map link, zone and phone, code, status, slot and check-in and call instants, `dock` (`{ code, hall }` while called, at the dock or loading), safety `{ status, validUntil }`, `privacyNoticeUrl`, `linkExpiresAt`; polled every 15 s; writes nothing

at `/briefings`; on a `link` session with an `rf_device` cookie it first links this phone's valid passes at the tenant to the booking (`link_acknowledgement` via `pass`) for instructions still missing; then `{ items: [{ instructionId, name, status, expiresAt, quiz, locales }] }`

`?locale=`; the published version in that locale, else en, else its first locale; `{ instructionId, version, locale, translation, title, blocks, questions, statement }`; questions without answers, and none while `safety.quiz` is off; 404 for an instruction that does not apply to the booking's site

post.description: `{ locale, name, confirmed: true }` → 201 `{ expiresAt }`; with a quiz and `safety.quiz` on, 409 `conflict` reason `quiz_not_passed` until the latest attempt passed; stores the acknowledgement through `recordAcknowledgement` with the session's channel, links it (`link_acknowledgement` via `completed`); on a `link` session with an expiry it sets `rf_device` (one year, `Path=/api/driver`) when absent and upserts the `safety_pass`; a `staff` session (gate device, YD-02) never does

`{ locale, answers: { <questionId>: <option index> } }` → `{ score, passed, attempts, wrong }`; passes at `safety.quiz_pass_percent`; counts every attempt in `safety_attempt` per booking and version; the latest attempt decides

get.description: Liveness and database check; 503 with `db: error` when the database does not answer.
`{ user, memberships, uiPrefs }` for the org picker and the stored UI state ([Module contract](module-contract.md#context-endpoints), [ADR-0014](../decisions/ADR-0014-user-ui-preferences.md))

patch.description: `{ name?, locale?, uiPrefs? }`; `uiPrefs` merges key by key into the stored object; answers like GET

get.description: The platform context of the signed-in platform admin.
`{ items: [{ id, values: [{ key, module, kind, soft, value }] }] }`, read-only
`{ scope: 'platform', siteId: null, items }`: every key with platform scope, shaped as in the tenant settings read

put.description: `{ value }` → the field. 400 for an unknown key or one without platform scope; 422 with the zod path under `["value", ...]`. Tenant and site rows stay

get.description: One page of tenants: `{ items: [{ id, name, package, createdAt, status, usage }], total, page, pageSize, facets: { package: { start, pro, enterprise }, status: { onboarding, active } } }`. `status` is `onboarding` while the tenant has no activation time, else `active`. Query (all optional): `q` searches the name as a case-insensitive substring, `package` filters by a comma-separated list of package ids, `status` by a comma-separated list of statuses, `sort` is `name` (default) or `createdAt`, `order` is `asc` (default) or `desc` with `id` as tiebreaker, `page` from 1 (default) to 10000, `pageSize` 10, 25 (default), 50 or 100; anything else is 422 at its path. `total` counts the tenants matching `q`, `package` and `status`; `facets.package` counts per package the tenants matching `q` and `status`, ignoring `package`, and `facets.status` per status those matching `q` and `package`, ignoring `status`. A page past the end has no items. `usage` holds one meter `{ used, limit, soft, over }` per limit, counted for the page rows only: `core.max_sites` (active sites), `core.max_docks` (active and maintenance docks), `core.max_internal_users` (members plus invitations that still work) and `booking.max_bookings_per_month` (bookings created since the first of the UTC month). `over` is `used > limit` and blocks nothing. Counted in the request transaction as the tenant with actor `system:usage`

post.description: `{ name, package, adminEmail }` → 201 tenant detail. Creates org (status `onboarding`), subscription and a `tenant_admin` invitation, and enqueues `core.invitation` in the platform default locale. Service: `createTenant` in `core/platform/tenants.ts`

get.description: `{ id, name, package, usage, entitlements: [{ key, module, kind, soft, value, source, packageValue? }], overrides: [{ key, value, expiresAt, note, active }], adminInvitations: [{ id, email, expiresAt }] }`. Reserved keys are left out; 404 for an id that is not a tenant

post.description: `{ email }` → 201 invitation; re-invites a tenant admin. A pending invitation to the same email is revoked and replaced

put.description: `{ value, expiresAt?, note? }`, `value` a boolean, a non-negative integer or `null` (unlimited) → the override. 400 `bad_request` with `reason` `unknown_key` or `reserved_key`, then 422 on `["value"]` for a value of the wrong kind. Applies from the tenant's next request

post.description: Runs with the token, then in the scope of the user. `{ token, name?, password?, companyName?, locale? }` → `{ carrierId }`. A new user needs `name` and `password` (422 without) and becomes carrier admin of a new org; a user signed in with the invited email links the carrier org they administer, and one who is only `carrier_user` answers 403 `forbidden` with `reason: 'carrier_admin_required'` and leaves the invitation pending; an email with an account answers 401 `sign_in_required` with `email`. The link is active, also when the tenant deactivated it before sending this invitation; a deactivation after it stays. Single use, 7 days. Service: `acceptCarrierInvitation` in `accept.redeem.ts`
`{ token }` → `{ tenantName, logoUrl, companyName, email, hasAccount }`; `logoUrl` as for `/api/public/links/:slug`

get.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes the platform admits sites in (`core.site_countries`), for the country select of the site form
The subdivisions of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country that have their own public holidays, for the region select of the site form; empty for a country without any

post.description: `{ token }`; 204 and `rf_driver=<token>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/driver; Max-Age=<seconds to the link's expiry>`; unknown, expired and revoked tokens answer the same 401 `unauthorized`; every call counts against `driver_exchange` (10 per minute per IP, 429 `rate_limited`); sets `driver_access.last_used_at`

Runs with the token, then in the scope of the org. `{ token, name?, password?, locale? }` → `{ orgId, orgKind }`. A user signed in with the invited email just joins. Otherwise an email with an account answers 401 with `reason: 'sign_in_required'`; a new user needs `name` and `password` (422 without) and gets a verified account and a session. Gate and dock site lists become `membership_site` rows. 409 `already_member` leaves the invitation pending. Service: `acceptInvitation` in `core/invitations/accept.redeem.ts`
`{ token }` → `{ orgKind, orgName, role, email, hasAccount }`; 401 when unknown, used, revoked or expired

get.description: Needs the tenant's `booking.public_link` and the site's `booking.public_link_enabled`. `{ tenantName, siteName, city, country, logoUrl }` (`logoUrl` is `null` without a logo or while `brand.logo` is off). 404 for an unknown or revoked slug, the feature or the site setting off, or an inactive site. The setting is the only on and off switch; the slug only names the link

post.description: Needs the tenant's `booking.public_link` and the site's `booking.public_link_enabled`. `{ companyName, country, contactName, email, locale? }`; always 202 with an empty body. A known email gets a sign-in prompt by email instead of the verification text, both with the single-use `/carrier-registration#<token>` link, so the response never reveals an account. Limits `registration_request` (5 per hour per email) and `registration_ip` (100 per hour per client address); over either the answer is the same 202 and nothing is written

get.description: Needs the tenant's module `brand`. The image with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; 404 for another hash, no logo or `brand.logo` off. URLs come from `logoUrl(tenantId, sha, origin?)` in `@rampflow/shared/modules/brand/api`, or `currentLogoUrl(tx, tenantId, entitlements, origin)` in `brand/logo/logo.ts`

post.description: `{ token }` → `{ carrierId, status }`; verifies the email, signs in, applies `booking.public_registration_mode`. A new email gets a verified account without password and a new carrier org; a known email answers 401 `sign_in_required` with `email` until that user is signed in, then attaches to the carrier org they administer; a user who is only `carrier_user` somewhere answers 403 `forbidden` with `reason: 'carrier_admin_required'` and the registration stays unverified. `auto_approve` links at once but leaves a link the tenant deactivated off. Single use, 24 hours; 401 once the site switched the public link off, the feature or site is off, or the slug the form came through was regenerated. Service: `verifyRegistration` in `verify.redeem.ts`

`SignupBody`; always 202 with an empty body once valid. 422 at `altcha` (`altcha_failed`) for a missing, wrong, expired or reused solution, at `email` (`disposable_email`) for a disposable domain, at `taxIdType` or `taxIdValue` (`tax_id_format`, `tax_id_checksum`, `tax_id_country`) for the tax id. A new email gets a pending registration and the `/signup/verify#<token>` email, superseding its earlier one; a known email gets a "you already have an account" email and no row. Limits `signup_request` (3 per hour per email) and `signup_ip` (20 per hour per client address); over either the answer is the same 202 and nothing is written

get.description: A signed ALTCHA proof-of-work challenge for the registration form, valid for 10 minutes. The widget solves it in the browser and sends the result as `altcha`; no cookie, no third party

post.description: `{ token }` → `{ email, companyName, possibleDuplicate }` for the verify page, before the click. Does not use the link. `possibleDuplicate` is true when another tenant has an equivalent tax id or a member at the same non-free-mail domain; it names no tenant. 401 for an unknown, used, superseded or expired link. Service: `inspectSignup` in `verify.redeem.ts`

`{ token }` → `{ tenantId, possibleDuplicate }`; in one transaction creates the tenant org (onboarding, the tax id with its initial status, `possible_duplicate`), its `start` subscription, the verified user with the chosen password and the only `tenant_admin` membership, then signs in, replacing any session. Single use, 24 hours: a used, superseded or expired link answers 401. An account with the email answers 409 `conflict` with `reason: account_exists` and the registration stays pending. Service: `verifySignup` in `verify.redeem.ts`

get.description: `?siteId&date&status&limit&cursor`; list view with the same summaries, by start

post.description: Needs `booking.force` when `force` is set. `{ clientRequestId, siteId, resourceId?, loadTypeId, startsAt, carrier: { id } | { name }, avis, force?, forceReason? }`; 201, or 200 with the first booking for a repeated `clientRequestId`; `forceReason` required with `force`

get.description: `?siteId&date`; columns per resource with `slots` (`capacity`, `booked` per grid slot) and `bookings` with `overCapacity`; polled every 15 s
`?q=`; actively linked carriers `{ items: [{ id, name }] }`
booking, avis, safety status

patch.description: Needs `booking.force` when `force` is set. Reschedule `{ startsAt, resourceId?, version, force?, forceReason? }`; moves the driver link expiry to the new start plus 7 days

put.description: `{ avis, version }`; from `checked_in` on, no capacity check

post.description: `{ reason? }` (send `{}` without one)

get.description: `{ url, expiresAt }`; 404 once the link is revoked

post.description: regenerate; answers the new `{ url, expiresAt }`
`{ email, locale }`; 202

get.description: `?limit&cursor`, oldest first; `actor` only with `booking.view_actors`
`{ logo: { url, contentType, byteSize, updatedAt } | null }`

put.description: raw PNG or JPEG up to 256 KB, checked by magic bytes whatever the `Content-Type` → `{ logo }`. A larger body answers 422 with issue code `too_big`; SVG and anything else 422 `invalid_format`

get.description: `?siteId&date&loadTypeId&loadUnits&resourceId?`; offered starts per resource and their union (`Offers` in `api.capacity.ts`), staff view without lead time and horizon
`?siteId=&from=&to=`

post.description: Adds a closure to a site or resource.

delete.description: manual closures only, a holiday answers 409 `holiday_closure`; an unknown id answers 404

post.description: holiday closures, a manual one answers 409 `manual_closure`; idempotent

put.description: Needs `booking.pools` when a pool is left or joined. `{ as: 'single', directions? } | { as: 'pool', resourceId }` moves the dock in one transaction and answers `{ resource }`; a single resource whose dock leaves is deactivated and reused, with its directions unless new ones are given, when the dock is booked as single again; a new single serves both directions and the load types of the resource the dock left; 409 `profile_mismatch` for a pool of another profile, 422 at `resourceId` for the default pool of another hall; idempotent

get.description: `?siteId=`

put.description: `{ siteId, resourceId: uuid | null, rows: [{ weekday, opens, closes }] }`

get.description: `?siteId=`

post.description: Needs `booking.duration_rules` for tiers. Adds a load type.

patch.description: Needs `booking.duration_rules` for tiers. Updates a load type.

put.description: Sets the resources that take a load type.

get.description: optional `?siteId=`

post.description: Needs `booking.pools` for pools. `{ siteId, kind, name, directions, capacityCap?, dailyCap?, dockIds }`; the docks share one profile (409 `profile_mismatch` otherwise) and move in from their resources, and the resource serves the load types of the resources they left

patch.description: Needs `booking.pools` for pools. Never cancels bookings

put.description: Needs `booking.pools` for pools. `{ dockIds }` of one profile; added docks move in from their resources, removed docks return to the default pool of their hall and profile; 409 `profile_mismatch` or `dock_needs_resource` (removed from their own default pool) with `dockIds`; 422 for a dock of another hall in a default pool; 409 `dock_without_load_type` if the docks would have no active load type

get.description: `{ links, invitations }`: linked carriers with name, country, status and source, and invitations neither accepted nor revoked

post.description: `{ companyName, email, locale? }` → 201; emails `booking.carrier-invitation` in `locale` (default the inviter's). A pending invitation for the same email is revoked, so inviting again resends

get.description: `{ items }`: per site the slug (or `null`), `enabled` (`booking.public_link_enabled`) and `mode` (`booking.public_registration_mode`)

post.description: `{ siteId }`; 201 when it creates the site's slug, 200 with the existing one; 404 for a site of another tenant
revokes the slug and issues a new one, for a link that leaked

get.description: `{ items }`, newest first, every status; each item carries the typed `companyName` and `carrierName`, the org verification bound (null before verification)

post.description: links the carrier (reactivating a deactivated link), emails `booking.registration-approved`; 409 `invalid_transition` with `status` unless `pending_approval`
`{ reason }`, emails `booking.registration-rejected`; 409 as for approve

get.description: The tenant context of the signed-in member: org, role, permissions, entitlements, the visible sites and their settings.

post.description: The body of `POST /privacy/search` plus `{ confirm: true }`; pseudonymizes bookings, restricts acknowledgements under retention
The body of `POST /privacy/search`; JSON download
`{ name?, phone?, plate? }`; matching bookings and acknowledgements

get.description: `?siteId&from&to&resourceId?&carrierId?`; dates are site-local
The KPI report of `GET /reports/kpis` as CSV, with the same filter.
paginated visit list with all timestamps
Every visit in the filter as CSV, with the timestamps in the time zone of the site.

post.description: same filters without paging, up to 50,000 rows; CSV format of [Time and formats](#time-and-formats)

get.description: `{ instructions, carriers }`: every instruction (archived too) with its non-draft versions, newest first, and the carriers of the bookings that have acknowledgements; the choices of the register filters, because `safety.view_register` alone cannot list instructions

post.description: `{ siteId?, carrierId?, driverName?, instructionId?, versionId?, status?, limit?, cursor? }`; newest first, paginated; `status` is `valid`, `visit_only`, `expired` or `outdated` from `acknowledgementStatus`; restricted rows (TN-06) are left out

get.description: `{ items }` with sites, archive time, published and draft version

post.description: `{ name, allSites, siteIds }`; version 1 draft from the 12-language platform template, de and en flagged `source`, the others `machine`; template questions only with `safety.quiz`; a site of another tenant answers 404

patch.description: `{ name?, allSites?, siteIds?, archived? }`; `allSites` and `siteIds` change together; `archived: false` counts against the limit again

get.description: `{ items }`, newest first, with locales, translation flags and question counts

post.description: new draft copied from the latest version (201); the open draft if one exists (200); without `safety.quiz` the copy drops its questions

get.description: all locales with questions, answers and content hash

put.description: Needs `safety.quiz` when questions are sent. `{ title, blocks, questions, statement, translation }`; draft only, else 409 `invalid_transition` with `status`; at most 5 questions, 2 to 4 options each

post.description: `{ materialChange }`; retires the previous version; with `safety.quiz`, 409 `conflict` reason `quiz_incomplete` with `locales`, `min`, `max` unless every locale has 3 to 5 questions; without it, 403 `entitlement_required` while any locale has questions; repeating it answers 200

get.description: `?siteId=` reads the site level, without it the tenant level: `{ scope, siteId, items: [{ key, module, scopes, value, source, inherited: { value, source } }] }` for every available key the level may hold

put.description: Needs the entitlement that the key's `requires` names. `{ siteId: uuid | null, value }` → the field. 400 for an unknown key or a level the key lacks (`scope_not_allowed`, `allowed`), 403 `entitlement_required` with the blocking feature, 422 under `["value", ...]`, 404 for another tenant's site

get.description: a site-limited operator sees only its sites; `{ items, usage: { sites, docks } }` counts active sites and active and maintenance docks against `core.max_sites` and `core.max_docks`

post.description: seeds the three load types, imports holidays, writes the weekly hours

get.description: One site of the tenant; 404 for a site of another tenant.

patch.description: Checks `core.max_sites` when activating. Unknown zone answers 422

get.description: The docks of a site.

post.description: Puts the dock into the default pool of its hall and profile, or a single resource of its own without `booking.pools`. 409 `conflict` with reason `duplicate_code`, or `dock_without_load_type` if its resource would serve no active load type; a hall of another site answers 422

patch.description: Updates a dock. Checks `core.max_docks` when the dock leaves `inactive`. A new profile updates its single resource or moves it from its pool to the default pool of its hall and new profile (403 `entitlement_required` without `booking.pools`); a new hall moves it out of a default pool; a dock in no resource is placed.

get.description: The halls of a site.

post.description: Adds a hall to a site.

get.description: `{ members: [{ membershipId, userId, name, email, role, siteIds, self }], invitations: [{ id, email, role, siteIds, expiresAt, expired }] }`

post.description: The limit `core.max_internal_users` counts members plus pending invitations. `{ email, role, siteIds? }` → 201 invitation. `siteIds` only for gate and dock operators (422 on `["siteIds"]` otherwise, on `["siteIds", i]` for another tenant's site). A pending invitation to the same email is replaced and does not count twice; a member's email answers 409 `conflict` `already_member`

patch.description: `{ role?, siteIds? }` → the member; a role without a site list drops its `membership_site` rows

delete.description: access ends on the member's next request

post.description: `{ name }` (part of the driver name, at least 2 characters); `{ items }` of the tenant's acknowledgements of instructions that apply to the site and would be valid for this visit, newest first, at most 20; 409 `invalid_transition` once the visit cannot take a briefing
`{ acknowledgementId }`; `link_acknowledgement` with `via: 'gate_lookup'`; 409 `acknowledgement_invalid`
no body; issues a 30-minute `staff` driver access and returns `{ url, expiresAt }`
`{ dockId }`; `{ truck, outsideResource }`; 409 `dock_occupied`, 409 `dock_inactive`; from `called` a reassignment
`{ plateSeen? }`; 409 `safety_missing` under enforcement; the truck shows `safety.status = 'missing'` as a warning otherwise
`{ actualLoadUnits, discrepancyNote? }`
`{ reason? }`; 422 without a reason before `done`
`{ dockId? }`; 422 without a dock when none is assigned
`{ dockId? }`, as `dock`
`{ reason }` from the turn-away list; from `confirmed`, `no_show` or `checked_in`
back to `checked_in`; frees the dock

get.description: `?siteId`; `{ halls: [{ id, name, docks: [{ id, code, status, temperatureZone, adrAllowed, resourceId, occupant }] }], queue }`; inactive docks left out, maintenance docks kept; the queue holds `checked_in` trucks by slot start, with waits

`?siteId&date?` (`date` defaults to today at the site); `{ siteId, date, timeZone, items }` by start: the day's bookings except cancelled and requested ones, plus no-shows whose `no_show_at` falls on that day. Before check-in, `punctuality` is what a check-in now would record

`?siteId`; trucks in `checked_in` to `done`, whatever day they were booked for, by gate-in; each with `onSiteMinutes`, `waitMinutes` (from `max(checked_in_at, starts_at)` to the first dock timestamp, or to now) and `standgeld` (`onSiteMinutes` above `yard.standgeld_flag_minutes`)

post.description: `{ siteId, q }` (2 to 120 characters); exact booking code (case and surrounding whitespace ignored, so scanner input works), plate announced or seen (normalized), exact reference, or part of the carrier name; active visits and today's no-shows, nearest start first, at most 20

`{ clientRequestId, siteId, resourceId?, loadTypeId, carrier: { id } | { name }, plateSeen, outcome: 'check_in', avis }` or `{ ..., outcome: 'turn_away', avis?, reason }`. Starts at the grid slot containing now; never 409 for hours or capacity. 201 with `{ truck, safety }`: the truck in `checked_in` or `turned_away`, or in `confirmed` with `safety: 'missing'` when enforcement blocks the check-in; 200 with the first booking for a repeated `clientRequestId`. 422 on `loadTypeId` when no active resource takes the load type

Unauthorized.description: `unauthorized`: no valid session or driver link.

Forbidden.description: `forbidden` without the permission or from a foreign `Origin`, `entitlement_required` when the package does not include the module or feature (`details.key`).

NotFound.description: `not_found`: an unknown or malformed id, or an org the caller does not belong to.

LimitReached.description: `limit_reached` at a hard limit of the package (`details.key`, `details.limit`).
